title.zh: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
title.en: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent

current_state.zh: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a new AI agent for professionals and small businesses, launched as a research preview on iOS, Android, and the web to compete with Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots.
current_state.en: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a new AI agent for professionals and small businesses, launched as a research preview on iOS, Android, and the web to compete with Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic推出新AI智能体Claude Duet，正面迎战Muse
updates.title_en: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
updates.what_changed_zh:
Anthropic宣布推出AI智能体Claude Duet，面向专业人士和小企业主，以“研究预览”（research preview）形式上线。该产品提供iOS和Android独立应用，同时可通过网页版Claude（claude.ai）使用。

Duet使Anthropic进入与Meta的Muse、OpenAI的Dots相同的消费级与小企业智能体赛道，三大实验室在此领域已形成直接竞争。Anthropic官方材料将该智能体描述为“主动式”，会在有事需要用户处理时主动发消息提醒。

据The Verge报道，该智能体基于Claude Opus 5.5构建，Anthropic称其可处理收件箱、日历和后续跟进事项。Anthropic将该版本定位为研究预览而非完整正式发布的产品，其产品页面目前提供等候名单（waitlist）入口。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a new AI agent for professionals and small businesses, launched as a research preview on iOS, Android, and the web to compete with Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots.
updates.background_zh: Claude Duet进入的是一个已相当拥挤的智能体市场：Meta推出Muse，将其定位为运行在专用“Muse Secure VM”上的个人AI智能体；OpenAI则在2026年9月29日的DevDay 2026主题演讲上发布了“始终在线”的Dots智能体。此前Anthropic的Claude产品主要通过对话界面使用，而非主动式的独立智能体应用。
updates.background_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded agent market: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent running on a dedicated "Muse Secure VM," and OpenAI launched Dots as always-on agents at its DevDay 2026 keynote on September 29, 2026. Anthropic's previous Claude offerings were primarily accessed through chat interfaces rather than a proactive, standalone agent app.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布强化了三大实验室围绕“始终在线”AI智能体的竞争叙事，这一主题通常影响的是与AI相关的加密板块情绪，而非某一代币的基本面。传导路径主要是叙事与资金关注度流向智能体概念代币及AI算力、推理相关资产，而非直接的协议层面敞口。
updates.market_impact_en: The release feeds the competitive narrative around always-on AI agents from the three largest labs, a theme that typically moves sentiment in AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than any single token's fundamentals. Any transmission would run through narrative and attention flows toward agent-branded tokens and AI compute/inference-related assets, not through direct protocol exposure.
